# Google Chrome Settings Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Title**: Google Chrome
- **Current Tab Title**: Settings – Privacy and security
- **URL Bar**: `chrome://settings/privacy`
- **System Date and Time**: Oct 23 00:59
- **System Tray Icons**: Located at the top-right corner, including network, sound, and power icons.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons at the top-right corner.

## Browser Navigation Bar

- **Back Button**: Leftmost button, arrow pointing left.
- **Forward Button**: Next to Back button, arrow pointing right.
- **Refresh Button**: Circular arrow icon.
- **Address Bar**: Displays the current URL.
- **Star Icon**: For bookmarking the current page.
- **Profile Icon**: Circular icon with a person silhouette, currently showing "Person 1".
- **Menu Button**: Three vertical dots button, labeled "Finish update".

## Left Sidebar Navigation

- **Settings Title**: "Settings" with the Chrome logo.
- **Navigation Menu**:
  - You and Google
  - Autofill and passwords
  - Privacy and security (currently selected, highlighted in light blue)
  - Performance
  - Appearance
  - Search engine
  - Default browser
  - On start-up
  - Languages
  - Downloads
  - Accessibility
  - System
  - Reset settings
  - Extensions (with external link icon)
  - About Chrome

## Main Content Area

### Welcome Section

- **Title**: "Take the Privacy Guide"
- **Subtitle**: "Review key privacy and security controls in Chrome"
- **Action Buttons**:
  - "Get started" (blue button)
  - "No, thanks" (white button with blue outline)

### Safety Check Section

- **Title**: "Safety check"
- **Description**: "Chrome regularly checks to make sure your browser has the safest settings. We'll let you know if anything needs your review."
- **Action Button**: "Go to Safety Check" (blue button with white text)

### Privacy and Security Section

- **Title**: "Privacy and security"
- **List of Settings**:
  - **Delete browsing data**
    - Description: "Delete history, cookies, cache and more"
    - Right arrow icon for expansion
  - **Privacy guide**
    - Description: "Review key privacy and security controls"
    - Right arrow icon for expansion
  - **Third-party cookies**
    - Description: "Third-party cookies are blocked in Incognito mode"
    - Right arrow icon for expansion
  - **Ads privacy**
    - Description: "Customise the info used by sites to show you ads"
    - Right arrow icon for expansion
  - **Security**
    - Description: "Safe Browsing (protection from dangerous sites) and other security settings"
    - Right arrow icon for expansion
  - **Site settings**
    - Description: "Controls what information sites can use and show (location, camera, pop-ups and more)"
    - Right arrow icon for expansion

## Profile Dropdown Menu

- **Profile Name**: "Person 1"
- **Status**: "Not signed in"
- **Icons**:
  - Key icon
  - Credit card icon
  - Location pin icon
- **Sign-in Prompt**: "Sign in to get your passwords and more on all your devices"
- **Sign-in Button**: "Sign in to Chrome" (orange button)
- **Profile Management Options**:
  - "Customise profile" (with pencil icon)
  - "Close this profile" (with 'x' icon)
- **Other Chrome Profiles**:
  - "Open guest profile" (with guest icon)
  - "Add new profile" (with plus icon)
  - "Manage Chrome profiles" (with multiple users icon)

## System Tray and Desktop Icons

- **Left Sidebar Icons**:
  - Activities
  - Firefox
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Settings
  - Trash

## Desktop Environment

- **Application Launcher**: Grid of nine dots at the bottom-left corner.
- **Desktop Icons**: Visible on the desktop, including the application launcher icon.
